title: Parkio Daily for November 20, 2026
teaser: Pirates of Caribbean closes most of 2027 for major refurb; Festival of the Arts dates announced; Space 220 prices rise again.

breaking.title: Pirates of the Caribbean closes most of 2027 for major refurbishment
breaking.body: Magic Kingdom's Pirates of the Caribbean will shut down in early 2027 for nearly a year while Imagineering updates the caves, beach, and hurricane lagoon scenes with new magic and effects. No Jack Sparrow additions are planned, but the classic dark ride will see significant scene work.

parkioInsight.text: If you're planning a 2027 trip, Adventureland's other attractions — especially Jungle Cruise and Big Thunder — tend to absorb displaced crowds. Book early 2027 visits with this in mind or consider pushing to late 2027 when Pirates reopens.

bignews.title: 2027 EPCOT Festival of the Arts dates set for January 15 through March 1
bignews.body: EPCOT's Festival of the Arts returns January 15 and runs through March 1, 2027, with Disney Lorcana as the presenting sponsor. The event will feature new and returning visual artists, culinary creations, and live performances throughout World Showcase.

parkioInsight.text: Opening weekend typically sees lighter crowds than mid-festival dates. If you're chasing exclusive art or culinary items, visiting January 16–18 often means shorter lines at booths and better artist availability.

bignews.title: Space 220 raises prices again at EPCOT
bignews.body: The prix-fixe dining experience at Space 220 in EPCOT has increased prices for both lunch and dinner service. The popular restaurant continues to require reservations well in advance.

parkioInsight.text: With another price bump, Space 220 may not deliver value for budget-conscious guests. Consider Coral Reef or Garden Grill for similar theming at lower cost, especially if you're dining with kids who won't finish the prix-fixe portions.

bignews.title: Jiko at Animal Kingdom Lodge earns AAA Four Diamond rating
bignews.body: Jiko — The Cooking Place has been awarded a AAA Four Diamond designation, joining the top tier of Walt Disney World restaurants. The accolade recognizes food quality, service excellence, and atmosphere.

parkioInsight.text: Four Diamond status often drives reservation demand. If Jiko is on your list, book now for visits in the next 60 days — availability tends to tighten after awards announcements.

bignews.title: Disney announces first major investor event since 2020
bignews.body: CEO Josh D'Amaro confirmed Disney will host a dedicated investor presentation in May 2027, the first such event since the company's 2020 Investor Day. Parks, experiences, and upcoming project timelines are expected to feature prominently.

parkioInsight.text: Investor events historically precede major announcements for Walt Disney World and Disneyland expansions. If you're weighing 2028–2029 trip plans, waiting until after May 2027 may reveal new lands or attractions worth timing your visit around.

topstories.title: Five Disney World rides closing for December refurbishments
topstories.body: Five attractions across Walt Disney World will be down for scheduled maintenance throughout December, affecting ride availability during the holiday season. Guests should check individual park schedules before visiting.

parkioInsight.text: December closures typically hit lower-capacity attractions, but holiday crowds amplify the impact. Rope-drop your must-dos and use Lightning Lane strategically to offset longer waits on operational headliners.

topstories.title: Only five Disney Jollywood Nights dates remain available
topstories.body: Another night of Disney Jollywood Nights at Hollywood Studios has sold out, leaving just five separately ticketed holiday events open for booking. The after-hours celebration features exclusive entertainment, characters, and holiday treats.

parkioInsight.text: With sellouts accelerating, the remaining dates will likely close within days. If you're on the fence, book now — after-hours events historically offer walk-on waits for Tower of Terror and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster.

topstories.title: Living with the Land loses iconic tomato figure at EPCOT
topstories.body: A beloved tomato plant character display has been removed from Living with the Land's greenhouse scenes at EPCOT, marking a small but emotionally resonant change for longtime fans of the classic attraction.

parkioInsight.text: Living with the Land remains a walk-on during most hours, even with the nostalgic update. It's still one of EPCOT's best midday air-conditioned breaks when Future World gets crowded.

topstories.title: Disneyland After Dark 2027 event dates and themes revealed
topstories.body: Disneyland has announced the full 2027 After Dark lineup, including three returning fan-favorite themes plus one brand-new event. Separately ticketed evenings offer exclusive access, characters, and entertainment after regular park hours.

parkioInsight.text: After Dark tickets usually sell out weeks ahead for popular themes. If you're planning a Disneyland trip in spring 2027, locking in event tickets first lets you build park days around guaranteed low-crowd evenings.

topstories.title: New merchandise arrives at Disney's BoardWalk
topstories.body: A fresh wave of products has launched at the new retail location on Disney's BoardWalk, adding to the shopping options available between EPCOT and Hollywood Studios.

parkioInsight.text: BoardWalk shops see lightest traffic in the late morning before lunch crowds arrive. Stop by between 10–11am if you're walking from EPCOT's International Gateway for the best selection and shortest checkout lines.

topstories.title: Marvel launches Rock 'n' Roller Coaster Starring The Muppets comic
topstories.body: Marvel Comics announced a one-shot comic exploring the backstory of Hollywood Studios' reimagined Rock 'n' Roller Coaster Starring The Muppets attraction, set to release in February 2027.

parkioInsight.text: Tie-in comics sometimes drive nostalgia visits. If you haven't ridden the Muppets coaster yet, February may see a bump in demand — riding in January or early March typically means shorter waits.

topstories.title: Black Friday sale offers $100 off Disney World resort bookings
topstories.body: A limited-time Black Friday coupon will take $100 off Walt Disney World resort hotel stays, with early indications the discount may stack with existing 2027 offers. The sale launches soon.

parkioInsight.text: If you're holding off on a 2027 resort booking, the Black Friday window often delivers the year's best stackable savings. Check the offer as soon as it drops — popular resorts sell out discounted inventory fast.

icymi.title: Summer House on the Lake debuts warm cookie dough sundae at Disney Springs
icymi.body: The restaurant has added a viral-inspired warm cookie dough sundae to its dessert menu, joining a growing roster of indulgent treats at the Disney Springs dining location.

icymi.title: Disney Imagineering launches We Call It Imagineering video series
icymi.body: A new behind-the-scenes series inspired by Walt Disney's original Disneyland specials offers a look at how Imagineers design upcoming lands, attractions, and entertainment for parks around the world.

icymi.title: The Wonderful World of Disney: Holiday Spectacular airs November 30
icymi.body: The annual Disney holiday special returns to television on November 30, featuring musical performances and festive moments filmed at Walt Disney World throughout the season.

icymi.title: New Loungefly bags and wallets featuring Marvel and Muppets characters now online
icymi.body: Loungefly has released mini backpacks and wallets showcasing Doctor Doom, Cyclops, Pepe the King Prawn, and Oliver and Company designs, available for purchase through online retailers.

spotlight.title: Three police incidents hit Disney World in five-hour span Thursday
spotlight.body: Law enforcement responded to two separate altercations and a car theft across Hollywood Studios, Saratoga Springs Resort, and Disney Springs on Thursday evening, an unusually busy stretch for Orange County Sheriff's Office activity at the resort.

parkioInsight.text: Isolated incidents like these rarely affect park operations or guest safety broadly, but they're a reminder to stay aware of your surroundings in parking lots and crowded evening areas. Disney Springs tends to see heavier foot traffic — and occasionally higher tension — after 9pm on weekends.
